title: &eThe Ashen Codex
subtitle: Everything the dark will try, written in the margins. Press I.

quests.title: &eThe Ashen Codex
quests.subtitle: All a Runeborn must know.
description: Press &eI&r for your &6Status&r. The &6Codex&r inside it holds the rules of this world: runes, shrines, flasks, armaments, Sovereigns.
This chapter is the margin notes. Each page teaches one system and checks that you've actually used it.
&o"Read it twice. The dead have."&r

quests.title: The Green Bar
quests.subtitle: Stamina, and the roll that saves you.
description: Every swing and every roll spends &astamina&r. It comes back fast the moment you stop. Fight it down to nothing and your blows land at &c60%&r.
Tap &eLeft Alt&r to &6roll&r. A roll costs nearly two straight-sword swings, and for a third of a second nothing can touch you. Roll &ointo&r the blow, not away from it.
Spiders leap. Roll under the leap and cut as it lands.

quests.title: Arts and the Blue Bar
quests.subtitle: FP is spent, not owed.
description: Every armament carries a &6weapon art&r. Press &eR&r to unleash it. Arts cost &bFP&r, the blue bar, and recharge after a short cooldown.
Staves cast &bsorceries&r that scale with Intelligence; sacred seals cast &eincantations&r that scale with Faith. On a catalyst, &eR&r casts its bound spell.
&bMind&r raises your FP. It trickles back on its own, slowly. The Azure Flask is faster.

quests.title: Rest by the Flame
quests.subtitle: Heal, refill, and choose where you wake.
description: Use a placed &6Ember Shrine&r to kindle it. &aRest&r restores health and FP, refills your flasks and binds your return there when you fall. You can't rest with enemies close; neither could anyone else, which is why the shrines survived.
The menu holds the rest: &6Level Up&r, &6Reinforce&r, &6Infuse&r, &6Flasks&r, &6Travel&r, the &6Merchant&r, &6Relics&r, &6Crown Shards&r and &6Rebirth&r.

quests.title: Ember and Azure
quests.subtitle: Tears of the shrine flame.
description: The &6Ember Flask&r restores health; the &bAzure Flask&r restores FP. Use one to drink. Every charge comes back when you rest, and the shrine's &6Flasks&r service splits your charges between the two.
A &6Sunseed&r adds a charge, up to fourteen. A &6Hallowed Tear&r makes every sip stronger. Champions and Sovereigns carry them, and the Keeper will part with a Sunseed for enough shards and gold.

quests.title: Between Two Fires
quests.subtitle: The road is shorter if you've lit both ends.
description: A kindled shrine stays kindled, and every one is a door. Open &6Travel&r at any shrine to step out at another.
Kindle them where you'll need to come back: the mouth of a dungeon, the edge of the Ashlands, the road home.

quests.title: Runebearer
quests.subtitle: Two ladders, one climb.
description: &6Level Up&r at a shrine spends runes on one of eight attributes: &6Vigor&r (health), &bMind&r (FP), &aEndurance&r (stamina and poise), &6Strength&r, &6Dexterity&r, &bIntelligence&r, &eFaith&r and &dArcane&r (status and discovery). Your rune level is their sum.
Every rune level also grants an &6RPG level&r, with points for your &eK&r screen.
Reach rune level 50.

quests.title: The Smith's Service
quests.subtitle: Stones the dead leave behind.
description: &6Reinforce&r at a shrine spends runes and stones to raise an armament's plus. Standard steel climbs on &6Tempering Stones&r; unique armaments on &6Lustrous Stones&r.
The first stones are cheap: iron, flint and cobbled deepslate make two. The rest of the trade lives in &eThe Armory&r.

quests.title: Ink and Grace
quests.subtitle: Mark the fires. The map remembers the rest.
description: Your map is parchment and ink, fogged over every land you haven't walked. &eN&r hides the minimap, &eM&r opens the world map, &eCtrl+B&r places a marker.
Shrines don't mark themselves. Stand at yours, press &eCtrl+B&r and pick the &6Site of Grace&r emblem. On the world map, &eG&r lists every grace you've marked.
Where you die, the map leaves a &cBloodstain&r (it keeps the last three). Your last bed is your &aResting Place&r.

tasks.title: I marked a shrine as a Site of Grace

quests.title: Light in Your Pocket
quests.subtitle: Runes you hold are runes you can lose.
description: Everything you kill pays &6runes&r: more for higher levels, far more for champions and Sovereigns. They're held, not banked. When you die, they stay where you fell.

Sometimes the dead drop runes as an item: a &6Faded Rune&r is 200, a Lustrous 1,000, a Radiant 4,000. An item in your pack goes into your corpse when you die, not into the ash. Crush it when you're standing at a shrine, not before.

quests.title: &cEcho of the Fallen
quests.subtitle: Your death leaves a Remnant.
description: Where you fall, an &cEcho&r rises: &c"Echo of <you>"&r, wearing a copy of your armour and swinging a copy of your weapon, with twice the health it deserves. Fire won't touch it. It stands over your runes.
It rises as a zombie, a wither skeleton in the Ashlands, an enderman in the End. Put it down and walk into the glow.
Die again first and the Echo fades, with every rune it guarded. &7The Fractured Archive keeps its own rules; no Echo rises there.&r

quests.title: What the Corpse Keeps
quests.subtitle: Your things wait where you fell.
description: Your gear doesn't scatter. It stays in your &6corpse&r, lying where you died. Open it and take everything back with &6Transfer Items&r.
The Echo's armour is only a copy, and it drops nothing. The real thing is in the corpse it's standing on, which is exactly why it's standing there.

tasks.title: I took my gear back from my corpse

quests.title: Valor and the K Screen
quests.subtitle: Kills pay twice.
description: Kills also pay &6Valor&r. Valor fills your &6RPG level&r, and every level gives points for Vitality, Attack Power, Attack Speed, Protection, Toughness, Agility, Fortitude and Exploration.
Press &eK&r. Stage points with the arrow keys (&eShift&r for five), read the &7current → after&r preview, and press &eEnter&r to confirm.
A &6Remnant Shard&r is 15 Valor waiting to be crushed. Sneak to crush the stack.

quests.title: Earned, Not Found
quests.subtitle: Diamond is a promise you have to keep.
description: Some gear refuses a weak hand. &bDiamond&r tools and weapons need &612 Attack Power&r; diamond armour needs &612 Protection&r. &5Netherite&r asks for 30.
The tooltip tells you what's missing. Find the diamonds whenever you like. Spend the points before you swing.

quests.title: Reading the Threat
quests.subtitle: The dark has a number. Learn to read it.
description: A monster's level comes from where it rose: &7+1 for every 128 blocks from spawn, +1 every 4 days (up to 15), +1 for every 12 blocks below Y 32&r. Ruins set a floor: outposts 12, fortresses 20, strongholds 25, bastions 30, ancient cities 40. The Ashlands start at 15.
Your own level drags theirs a third of the way toward you. Kills above your level pay half again; kills far below pay a quarter.
Hold a &6Hunter's Lens&r to read the area. Look through it to read one monster whole.

quests.title: Crest and Rank
quests.subtitle: Some of them have died before.
description: Monsters that rose more than once wear a crest: &7Common&r → &aVeteran&r → &9Elite&r → &5Champion&r → &cRemnant&r. Each rank pays more experience (up to ten times), extra loot, a &6Remnant Shard&r and bonus Valor.
Don't mistake a &5Champion&r crest for a &6gold title&r. The gold title is the Sovereigns' mark, with affixes like Blazing or Warded, and it carries their Fragments.
&o"Every rank has a weakness. Every Remnant has a name. Learn both."&r &7— Ilse, the Huntmaster&r

quests.title: Nothing Left to Hide
quests.subtitle: Sixteen ways to die, four at a time.
description: Ranked monsters carry &etraits&r, listed under their name. Read them before you swing.

&eVolatile&r explodes after it dies: step away. &eThornskin&r returns melee damage. &eDeflecting&r shrugs off arrows. &eWarded&r regrows its shield if you let it rest. &ePackleader&r calls copies once wounded. &eBlinking&r ends up behind you.
Kill a monster with four traits.

quests.title: Accept the Challenge
quests.subtitle: Make it worse. Get paid double.
description: A &6Brand of Challenge&r, used on a leveled monster, lifts it one rank, five levels and one trait, and doubles what it pays. A Remnant can't rise any higher, which is the only mercy in the description.
Craft one from Remnant Shards and an echo shard, or trade shards to the Huntmaster.

quests.title: &cA Remnant's End
quests.subtitle: A name, a title and a grudge.
description: Rarest of all is a &cRemnant&r: a named echo with a title, rising only past level 30. It never despawns. Its horn carries 48 blocks (&o"A Remnant stirs nearby"&r), it wears a boss bar, and when it falls the whole world hears who did it.
Bring full flasks. Read its traits through the Lens first.

quests.title: The Hunter's Moon
quests.subtitle: Some full moons come up red.
description: On about one full moon in three, a toll sounds and the &cHunter's Moon&r rises. Until dawn, monsters spawn five levels stronger, ranks come twice as often and shards drop double.
An icon on your HUD tells you it's up. Survive one first. Then learn to farm it.

tasks.title: Slay a ranked monster under a Hunter's Moon

quests.title: Fragments, Sigils, Relics, Crowns
quests.subtitle: How a Sovereign is called, and what it leaves.
description: Gold-titled champions carry &6Sovereign Fragments&r. Six Fragments and the right token make a &6Sigil&r. Use it, and a Sovereign answers.

A felled Sovereign leaves a &6Relic&r, exchanged at a shrine for one of two legendary armaments, and most leave a &6Crown Shard&r: use it to claim its blessing, then wear one at a time from a shrine. The Old Powers keep relics too.
Each Sovereign's first fall rekindles an ember of &6The Long Eclipse&r for everyone. &e/lastlight eclipse&r shows the count.

tasks.title: Call a Sovereign with its Sigil

quests.title: The Dead Hoard
quests.subtitle: Four small sins make a bigger one.
description: Monsters drop &6loot bags&r: Common, Uncommon, Rare, Epic, Legendary, &dMythic&r. Hold use to open one; hold &eShift&r over it to read its real odds.

Four bags of a tier craft into the next (Mythic also wants a nether star), and any bag splits back into four. Odd ones turn up: &cCursed&r bags gamble, &6Hourglass&r bags ripen if you wait, &bLocked&r bags want a Diamond Key cut from a diamond.
Combine four Uncommon bags and open the Rare.
